description: SECURITY ALERT: Our spam filter has failed and 10 unsolicited emails have bypassed it and landed in your inbox mixed with legitimate email. Your tasks: (1) Carefully review your inbox and identify all spam/suspicious emails — look for telltale signs such as suspicious senders, weight-loss offers, adult content, prize notifications, or phishing attempts. (2) Move all spam you find to the Junk folder. (3) Create a new IMAP folder named exactly 'Spam-Incidents' and move at least 3 of the most egregious spam examples into it for the security team's review. (4) Draft an email to security-response@company.com with subject 'Spam Filter Bypass Incident Report' — the body must list the subject lines of the spam emails you identified, state the total count found, and describe what types of spam were present. Login: username ga, password password123.
